_note: Run paths (Yusuf, 2026-10-27, plan https://claude.ai/artifact/6v3b5DfbBM3B4xwYJvj3Cu): four ways to specialise a run, each tiers deep (RunState.paths: path -> tier held). A founding tradition's path (path in data/traditions.json) starts at tier 1; each age-up brings a charter (RunState.charters_due), a pick of charter_choices paths' next tier at the next build phase (RunState.charter_offer, choose_charter). Tier II (slice 2) adds a new rule and takes something from another kind of person; its text says both. Tier III (slice 3) is the capstone, the flashiest thing in the run, with no further cost. Each tier: text (what it does, for the card), effects (summed with relics' and traditions' in RunState.mod(), same keys), dawn_card (a townsfolk role, or hero, always among the dawn cards when the pool has one: People.offer_picks). A path's buildings come up path_card_weight times as often in the blueprint draft (data/balance.json), like a tradition's. Effect keys only paths use so far: warrior_food_saving (share of each warrior's food the town saves), patrol_ease (warriors count this many more toward patrol pairs and squads), caravan_early (the southern caravan comes without its building), path_band_ease (every leaning bands this many sooner, not on top of a tradition's own ease), heirlooms (a fallen hero's best item waits for the next hero to arrive, People.bury_heroes/add_hero), drill_xp (heroes drilling, by the hearth or at a yard, earn this share more XP), fewer_tribes (this many fewer tribesperson cards dealt each dawn), muster (on the warned night tribespeople take up spears and hit with this share of a warrior's blow; the Levy hall and Levy horn make it a full blow), dusk_stakes (at the warned dusk the town barricades the attack's way as if raiders were spotted there, FolkAI.raise_alarm), no_escort (warriors no longer keep watch over gatherers by day), guild_band (a band this size can be chartered as a trades guild, below its top band tier), guild_craft_speed (every workshop works this share faster), hero_card_scarcity (hero cards come up this share less often at dawn), hired_blades (the caravan always lays out deals marked only_with hired_blades: warriors hired for the round, data/trades.json), folk_card_shells (tribesperson and warrior dawn cards cost this many shells), path_legend (each dawn with no living legend, the highest-level hero becomes the town's Legend: legend_levels levels up and a mythic item of the age; People.crown_legend), legend_aura (warriors within aura_reach of the Legend hit this share harder), sergeants (a warrior with the promotion's kills becomes a sergeant at dawn instead of being offered as a hero, with sergeant_hp more HP; People.raise_sergeants), sergeant_aura (warriors within aura_reach of a sergeant, the sergeant too, hit this share harder; one aura of each kind counts), masterwork_blue and masterwork_yellow (the chance each workshop's gear comes out blue, with at least one affix, or yellow, with at least two; Market.finish_craft), curio_dealer (the caravan lays out the curio deal every round: one named relic, its price by the relic's rarity, curio_prices in data/trades.json).

heroes.name: Heroes
heroes.text: A town that lives by its champions.

tiers.text: A hero card at every dawn once heroes have somewhere to sleep. Training yards, kennels, duelling rings and trophy halls come up twice as often.
Heirlooms: a fallen hero's best item waits for the next hero to arrive. Heroes drilling earn half again as much XP. Cost: one fewer tribesperson card each dawn.
Legend: at each dawn with no legend living, your highest-level hero becomes the town's Legend, 3 levels up and carrying a mythic item. Warriors near the Legend hit 20% harder.

warband.name: Warband
warband.text: A town that holds its edge with spears.

tiers.text: A warrior card at every dawn. Warriors eat half as much, and they patrol in pairs and squads one warrior sooner.

Muster: on the warned night tribespeople take up spears and fight at half a warrior's strength, and at dusk the town barricades the attack's way. Cost: warriors no longer keep watch over gatherers by day.
Sergeants: a warrior with 6 kills becomes a sergeant at dawn instead of leaving to be a hero, with 15 more HP. Warriors near a sergeant hit 20% harder.

guilds.name: Guilds
guilds.text: A town that grows by its hands.

tiers.text: One more dawn card, always a tribesperson among them. Every band forms one member sooner (not on top of your tradition's own band).
A band of 4 can be chartered as a trades guild, and every workshop works 30% faster. Cost: hero cards come half as often.
Masterworks: workshops roll their gear like cards. One piece in four comes out blue, one in twenty yellow, so stalls sell better gear to heroes.

trade.name: Trade
trade.text: A town that buys what it can't grow.

tiers.text: The southern caravan comes from the start, without waiting for its building, and lays out rarer deals twice as often. Traders leave 5 more shells every round.
Sellswords: every round the caravan offers hired blades, three warriors who fight for this round only and need no beds. Cost: tribesperson and warrior cards cost 3 shells each.
Curio dealer: every round the caravan offers one named relic for shells, dearer the rarer it is.
